description.text: This major aims to cultivate high-quality applied specialized talents in stomatology who master the basic knowledge, theories and skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, as well as the professional knowledge and skills of stomatology, and are competent for the diagnosis and treatment of common oral diseases. The main courses include Introduction to Stomatology, Oral Biology, Oral Anatomy and Physiology, Oral Histopathology, Oral and Maxillofacial Medical Imaging Diagnosis, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Endodontics, Periodontology, Oral Mucosal Diseases, Pediatric Stomatology, Prosthodontics, Orthodontics, Preventive Stomatology, Oral Materials Science, Geriatric Stomatology, and Oral Equipment Science, etc.This major lasts for six years, including one year of professional internship, and confers a Bachelor of Medicine degree.

duration.text: The Stomatology at Southern Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of the information page of the valid passport;2 Highest academic degree certificate. Fresh graduates should submit the expected graduation certificate (original scanned copy and English translation). After being pre-admitted, fresh graduates must submit their academic degree certificates to obtain the admission qualification.3 Transcripts of all courses in the highest academic education stage (original scanned copies and English translations);4. Id photo (2-inch bareheaded photo with a blue background)5 A scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" (please keep the original for yourself), which must be filled out in either Chinese or English.6. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);7. Proof of language proficiency8. The scanned copies of the "International Student Financial Guarantee Form" and its guarantee materials must be filled out in either Chinese or English. Provide a deposit certificate sufficient to cover reasonable expenses such as study, living, and international travel during the student's study in China (the deposit amount should be no less than 150,000 RMB), as well as a scanned copy of the passport or identity proof of the financial guarantor (only a relative of the student) (for self-funded program applicants).9. Two copies of the "Guardian's Guarantee Letter" (which must be notarized), signed (provided by self-funded project applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2025. If the notarization place is not in China, it also needs to be affixed with the notarization mark of the Chinese embassy or consulate in the local area).The guardian should be a Chinese or foreign adult who is a resident of China and has a stable source of income.★ Certificates and transcripts must be official documents.When necessary, our school may require applicants to submit supplementary materials.Whether admitted or not, all the above materials will not be returned.All the above forms can be downloaded from the website of the International Education College of Southern Medical University.

requirements.text: 1. Not of Chinese nationality but holding a valid foreign passport.And there is a record of having actually resided abroad for more than two years within the last four years (up to April 30 of the admission year).2. Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.3. Aged 18 to 30, with a high school diploma or above.4. Diligent and eager to learn, with good academic performance, upright conduct, abiding by laws and regulations, no record of violating school rules and regulations, no record of public security penalties, and no criminal record.5. Language proficiency requirements:(1) Those with a basic level of Chinese proficiency must submit proof of their Chinese proficiency, such as training certificates or HSK level certificates. If the Chinese proficiency is zero, they must participate in the Chinese proficiency training organized by the school before enrollment. (2) Applicants whose native language is not English must provide proof of IELTS Academic (no less than 6.0, with no less than 5.5 in each section), TOEFL (no less than 80 in IBT, with no less than 15 in each section), or other equivalent English test scores. Applicants whose native language is English or whose highest academic degree was taught entirely in English may be exempted from the English test score certificate, but they must submit a certificate of English teaching issued by their graduating school.
